incidents.title: Payments hang every checkout
incidents.brief: The payment provider is down and every checkout thread waits 30 seconds.
incidents.constraint: The rest of the site could still browse.
incidents.question: What stops the thread pileup?

choices.label: Trip breaker
choices.resultBody: Open a circuit after consecutive failures and fail fast instead of waiting on the timeout.

choices.label: Longer timeout
choices.resultBody: Calls keep waiting on the dead dependency.

choices.label: Retry harder
choices.resultBody: Retry every call immediately
